prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on what you need (realistic AI presenters vs. quick social templates, budget, languages, level of control, output size, etc.). Below are top choices by strength and when to pick each.

Top picks (quick summary)
- Synthesia — Best for realistic AI presenters/avatars and polished corporate ads. Multilingual, high-quality avatars, enterprise features. Good if you want a human-like spokesperson without actors.
- HeyGen (aka Movio/varies by region) — Strong alternative for lifelike avatars and fast script→video. Often a bit cheaper than Synthesia for similar use cases.
- Elai.io / Colossyan — Good for presenter videos and scaling many short personalized videos.
- Canva — Best all-around for quick, template-based social ads with simple AI tools, extensive assets, brand kits and easy resizing for platforms.
- InVideo / Promo.com / FlexClip — Great for fast, affordable social ad creation from text or templates; lots of stock assets and preset aspect ratios.
- Pictory — Best for turning long-form content (blogs/long videos) into short social ads using AI highlights and captions.
- Opus Clip / Repurpose tools — Best for automatically creating short vertical clips from longer videos (for Reels/TikTok).
- Shakr — Strong for e-commerce and dynamic ad templates tailored to Facebook/Instagram campaigns (used widely by retailers).

How to choose (criteria)
- Use case: presenter/brand spokesperson → Synthesia/HeyGen/Elai. Quick social ads from templates → Canva/InVideo/Promo. Repurposing long videos → Pictory/Opus Clip.
- Budget: free/cheap → Canva, InVideo (freemium). Mid/enterprise → Synthesia, HeyGen, Shakr.
- Customization: need full creative control → InVideo/Canva. Want speed & scale (many personalized ads) → Elai/Synthesia + automation/API.
- Languages & voices: Synthesia and HeyGen have many languages and natural voices. Canva/InVideo have simpler TTS.
- Output & ad testing: if you need dynamic creative optimization and platform integrations, consider Shakr or an agency/platform that supports DCO.

Recommendation
If you want one crisp recommendation:
- For polished, presenter-style ads: Synthesia (or HeyGen to save some cost).
- For fast, scalable social ad creation and templates: Canva or InVideo.
- For repurposing long videos into many short ads: Pictory or Opus Clip.

If you tell me: what platform (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), budget, whether you need an AI presenter, and whether you have brand assets, I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a suggested workflow.
